source: author's tier table (2026-09-19) + 3.2 CARRIER_LIBRARY science + Claude-thread N30/N31 empirics
note: A recipe is what makes a tier CLAIM true at render: signal tags (the claim), carriers (the mechanism), counter-NEG (the boundary), prose floor (what survives PH). The rating gate grades every slot against its declared tier's recipe.

PG13.name: the tease tier
PG13.carrier_note: skin-framing (S) and exposure-positioning (E) lead; fabric states stay non-sheer; B shape-telegraph at L/M degree
PG13.prose_floor: state nouns >= 2; the outfit IS the claim

R.name: the underwear tier
R.carrier_note: layers negotiate (L) and context undresses (U); the D kinetic axis makes the pose erotic (the author's table puts the POSE in the signal set); waistband/strap/cup states are the vocabulary
R.prose_floor: state nouns >= 3; underwear state named explicitly, never implied

RPLUS.name: the edge tier
RPLUS.carrier_note: sheer/imprint/compression physics; cameltoe is I-class (imprint) by science; CORE-4 mandatory (>=4 classes x 4 mechanism groups); sheer-family <=2 carriers per prompt
RPLUS.prose_floor: state nouns >= 4; the fabric's PRESENCE must be claimed as hard as what shows through it (the counter-NEG is what holds the tier)

X.name: the bare tier
X.carrier_note: bare-state nouns stated plainly and at least doubled in prose (the render-confirmed half of the old recipe); situational (U) or fantasy amplification stages the bareness; open mouth is an OPTIONAL amplifier, never a requirement (the stub is retired); composition and light do the art — the body is already the claim
X.prose_floor: state nouns >= 4; the bare state named in both tag block and prose (the doubling law); staging (where/light/witness) carries the dignity
X.opener: anime style, ecchi anime style, hentai anime style
X.platform_note: X posts are algorithmically suppressed on Yodayo — art-for-art slots, default 2 per batch

XXX.name: never
XXX.note: a sexual act — NEVER used, ever. Hard floor. Any XXX signal in POS is a hard-gate failure of the whole batch.
